name: Tekstuur
author: BARNIR
tagline: four layers of slowly moving sound
description: Tekstuur for the M-VAVE FM-1: four layers that each play a recorded source as slowly shifting loops or a cloud of grains, mixed with a vector point that drifts by itself, through chorus, delay and reverb.
credits: Tekstuur by BARNIR. Platform: fm1-base and felucca-bsp (MPL-2.0). Sources: VSCO-2 CE and VCSL by Versilian Studios (CC0).
